scope: Selected lifetime chronology; not an exhaustive CV.

events.event: Played snare drum in the Mocidade Alegre samba-school percussion section.
Studied at Conservatório Antonino Simalha.
Founded Coitado do Próximo as composer and drummer.
Participated in BBS environments including SP Online/STI and Mandic; created the experimental Minduim BBS using RemoteAccess and two telephone lines.
Maintained a cultural column on Tremonte BBS.
Presented and curated the weekday Metrópole radio program on Rádio Nova Paulista FM 103.7.
Coitado do Próximo recorded the demo Pegue o seu Celular / Mulher SP; Marcelo Nicchio was interviewed by Kid Vinil on 97FM; the band opened for 365 at Aeroanta.
Recorded the first Coitado do Próximo album, Meu Querido Diário, at Estúdio Asas, produced by Edson X; the work was independently released on CD in 1998.
Worked in executive production/fundraising for Homens na Cozinha, broadcast by Band.
events.evidence: autobiographical; external credits to be checked

events.event: Worked through Nicchio & Associados as a cultural producer and contributed to fundraising connected to the feature films Carandiru and Domésticas.
events.evidence: preserved business card for cultural-producer role; project-specific fundraising remains autobiographical/private archive

events.event: Pre-produced the second Coitado do Próximo album, Eu Não Tô Nem Aí, co-produced by Fábio Badi Crepaldi and Marcelo Nicchio.
Coitado do Próximo opened for Os Paralamas do Sucesso at Olympia in São Paulo, at a sold-out show with an estimated audience of about 6,000 people.
events.evidence: public video plus autobiographical audience estimate

events.event: Worked at PSINet in corporate hosting sales.

Worked at Livraria Cultura after leaving PSINet, in a three-month summer job selling technical books. This remains part of the Full Biography chronology only, not the Internet & Performance thematic axis.
events.evidence: preserved business card for association; dates, role and summer-job classification autobiographical

events.event: Appeared in Folhateen / Folha de S.Paulo in the edition whose printed cover line was Órfãos do Rock; internal article: Onde estão os ídolos?.

Coitado do Próximo appeared on Programa do Jô; the program was recorded and broadcast the same day, with transmission through Rede Globo Internacional, and the band performed Estava Comigo, composed by Marcelo Nicchio.
events.evidence: public video plus autobiographical broadcast details

events.event: Wrote the Prateleira Cultural column and other pieces for Sinal Verde magazine, including recurring digital-culture topics such as RSS, Skype/VoIP, Google Earth, online radio and Orkut.

Created and operated Mirantte News; preserved contemporary material identifies Marcelo Nicchio as director of the portal. The need to generate traffic for the product led into the later specialization in Search.
Credited for Artistic Direction and co-Executive Production of Meia-Noite e Uns on RedeTV!; Dreamsnetwork.tv identified as production entity.
Deepened professional work in SEM and completed certifications under the Google Advertising Professional program.
Worked at CookieWEB, progressing from SEM coordination to management.
Worked at Petlove on the internalization of digital media operations.

Founded Clickland Digital with Carlos Portela in September 2012. Regular commercial activity later wound down, while the company remains active as a backup operating/legal structure rather than Marcelo Nicchio's primary current professional activity.
events.evidence: preserved website/business material plus autobiographical founder and continuity details

events.event: Worked at BEST within the Kenshoo ecosystem and taught advanced Search and Social segmentation workshops for E-Commerce Brasil.
Worked at Ad.Dialetto, including work connected to Máquina de Vendas / Ricardo Eletro.
events.evidence: preserved business card for agency association; account responsibility and operating details autobiographical

events.event: Worked independently on digital media and performance projects across different companies and segments.
Developing O Arquiteto da Apoteose, a documentary project about Sidnei França; unfinished work in progress.
Developed the Autópsia content/television project during the pandemic; project not released.
Worked remotely at Driven.cx in a full-time agency operation.
Coitado do Próximo reunited for a surprise performance at Cassasp.
Began the current independent Human–AI Interaction research cycle.
Published four Melissa 1.0 research works on Zenodo, each with its own DOI.
Released The Punk Rock Orchestra v1, with instances on OSF, SSRN, Zenodo, PubPub and GitHub.
Developing Punk Rock Orchestra v2 as the intended definitive version closing the current Melissa → PRO research cycle.
events.note: No future DOI, repository deposit or formal publication is asserted until it exists publicly.
